product_one_liner.value: Fly.io is a developer-focused public cloud that runs applications and AI-agent workloads on hardware-isolated Linux virtual machines, sandboxes, and managed databases.

eng_blog.notes: The index contains multiple engineering/infrastructure posts, including posts on Firecracker, SQLite/LiteFS, networking, and distributed systems.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open-jobs index lists platform security, full-stack, infrastructure operations, and networking engineering roles, with no qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.notes: Public materials mention AI products and list Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenRouter for internal tooling, but do not identify a model provider used by the Fly.io product itself.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The open-jobs index lists four engineering roles and no SDR, BDR, sales representative, business-development representative, or account-executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: The July 24, 2026 announcement introduced Fly.io’s computers-for-agents direction and related product positioning, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The July 24, 2026 announcement says Scott Johnston joined as CEO; Kurt Mackey transitioned to an advisory role.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The cited subprocessor page names HubSpot and Snowflake as CRM, and Customer.io and Mailgun for newsletter/transactional email.
